initial_context.disclosed: Entry URL and environment metadata only.

outcome: Stopped at the first usable buyer-unsigned quote.

ordered_calls.result: Listing retrieved; disclosed homepage and MCP URL.
Homepage retrieved; disclosed prices and catalog URL.
Catalog supplied cheapest-item claim, price, required input and delivery contract. Tool output was truncated.
Usable payment challenge with required-input schema, payment template and seller-signed offers.

request_budget.caveat: Web-tool internal fetching and caching are not independently observable.

selection.basis: Homepage and catalog identify this as the cheapest paid item; quote confirms price.
selection.suitability_assumption: A minimal signed observation artifact satisfies the unspecified shopping goal.
selection.subject_caveat: Quote reports never_observed=true and zero observation rounds. This would document absent observations, not assess endpoint quality.

required_input_knowledge.payment_requirements: A funded wallet and a signed payment for one current accepted network would be needed to proceed.

deliverable_understanding.expected: Instant response containing existing recorded observations, dates, coverage and gaps, plus an Ed25519-signed certificate, patron number, badge URL and verification URL.
deliverable_understanding.limits: No fresh probe. An unobserved subject returns not_observed. Signature validity does not establish observation truth.
deliverable_understanding.free_alternative: The underlying recorded facts are available without purchasing; payment adds a signed, certificate-bound copy.

interpretation_402.meaning: Expected x402 v2 payment negotiation, not a purchase, delivery, authentication failure or source outage.
interpretation_402.terms: Exact payment of 1000 atomic USDC units; 300-second timeout.
interpretation_402.unsigned_meaning: Buyer supplied no payment signature. Seller-signed JWS offers were present but not cryptographically verified.
interpretation_402.next_step_not_exercised: Sign an accepted payment and retry the same input-bearing URL with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

guesses: Chose the store's hostname as the subject because the user specified none.
tool_limitations: Catalog output truncation prevented exhaustive inspection of all items.
Web results did not expose origin HTTP status codes.

access_constraints.caveat: The first curl invocation omitted -q, so automatic curl configuration loading was not explicitly disabled; no configuration contents were exposed. The quote invocation used -q.

result_verification.reason: No purchase artifact exists; stopped immediately after the usable quote.
result_verification.documented_method: Retrieve the delivered certificate's verification URL and validate its signature with the published store key.
